flags.message: CourtListener MCP returned HTTP 429 (daily limit 1400/day already exceeded, ~53 minutes to reset) on the first two calls, so the Federal Circuit opinion below and the Dolby v. Unified Patents (25-1011) briefs were not read through MCP. The cell proceeded on the provisioned petition/BIO, the statpack, and two web fetches of public supremecourt.gov / justice.gov pages.

Decisive forward signal from public information pre-dating the snapshot: the Court denied Dolby Laboratories v. Unified Patents, No. 25-1011 (same 314(d)/RPI reviewability family, Director opposing as respondent) on June 22, 2026, as Qualcomm's BIO itself reports. Used as a prior, not as this case's outcome, which is unknown to me.

The docket's 'Response Requested' (Aug 28, 2026, after both respondents waived) is the strongest grant signal here but is not part of the sal-v4 band, which froze as baseline; the statpack carries no call-for-response cut, so the lift applied to the anchor rests on general knowledge of the paid docket.
